publication.body:
Closes #1109

CodeFriend now generates an evidence-bound 4+1 architecture package through the installed native journey and carries it through existing approved Markdown, HTML and PDF exports. Shared entity IDs, exact source citations, scenario traces, editable Mermaid and rendered diagrams remain bound to the admitted revision; missing evidence produces explicit partial output.

Validation: 14 package and 21 native journey tests passed, including complete/partial/conflicting fixtures, response reconstruction, fenced JSON, expiry/deletion, replay and export-tamper rejection. Installed ADL and bounded CodeFriend.ai generation and retrieval passed on the recorded clean candidates. PDF fixture pages were visually inspected; browser visual inspection remains unavailable. Final native proof and independent review bind the publication head.

Hosted/paired activity integration remains #1101 and website #6. Independent Beta 1 qualification remains #915; these native demonstrations do not satisfy it. See docs/milestones/v0.92.2/evidence/issue-1109/ for revisions, hashes and limits. CI and merge readiness are separate.
